datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
A soccer ball is kicked with a launch speed v0 at an angle θ above the horizontal (neglect air resistance). What is the speed of the ball at its maximum height?
A. v0 [incorrect] Explanation: This ignores that the vertical component of velocity decreases to zero at the top.
B. v0 cos θ [correct] Explanation: At maximum height the vertical velocity is zero, so the speed equals the unchanged horizontal component v0 cos θ.
C. v0 sin θ [incorrect] Explanation: This confuses the initial vertical component with the speed at the peak, where the vertical component is actually zero.
D. 0 [incorrect] Explanation: Only the vertical component becomes zero at the top; the horizontal component remains nonzero.
